text:
ANTIFRAUD::alert_http_referrer
Description
This iRules command returns HTTP referrer.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
alert_http_referrer
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"Alert HTTP referrer: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_http_referrer]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
